create_utm_data_generator: create a UTMDataGenerator instance to sample sequences from programs using a UniversalTuringMachine
sample_programs_from_utm: sample random programs from a UniversalTuringMachine with a given maximum program length
run_programs_and_generate_sequences: run sampled programs on the UTM and generate one-hot encoded sequences with loss masks
configure_ascii_tokenizer: configure the UTMDataGenerator to use ASCII tokenization for output character encoding
configure_seq_position_tokenizer: configure the UTMDataGenerator to use SEQ_POSITION one-hot tokenization within the UTM alphabet size
